lessons.title: كان: was and were
lessons.learn: كان = was/were! كان كبيرا (he was big), كانت جميلة (she was beautiful). Stories: كان يدرس = he WAS studying (كان + present = was doing!). Unlock the storytelling past!

grammar.title: كان + word / كان + present
grammar.explain: كان مدرسا (he was a teacher), كانت جميلة (she was beautiful). كان يدرس = he was studying. كنتُ (I was), كنتَ (you-m were), كنتِ (you-f were)!
mistakes: Saying أنا كان — I-was is كنتُ!
Saying كانت جميلةٌ with ة-damma — كان's خبر takes -اً/-ةً!

dialogue.en: I was at the party. It was beautiful!

lessons.title: Dual: كتابان
lessons.learn: Arabic has a DUAL — a special TWO form! كتابان (two books), يومان (two days), مدرستان (two schools-f). Just add -ان! 1–2 come AFTER nouns: كتاب واحد, يومان اثنان!

grammar.title: Dual with -ان
grammar.explain: كتاب→كتابان, يوم→يومان, مدرسة→مدرستان. Verbs too: يدرسان (they-two study)! Dual is everywhere — two eyes (عينان), two hands (يدان)!
mistakes: Forgetting feminine ة→ت: مدرستان, not مدرسةان!

dialogue.en: How many books do you have? (to m)

lessons.title: Imperative: ادرس!
lessons.learn: Give orders! ادرس! (study! -m), ادرسي! (study! -f), اجلس! (sit!), تعال! (come!), اذهب! (go!). Soften with من فضلك: اجلس من فضلك = Please sit. Command + please = polite power!

grammar.title: Imperative: ادرس/ادرسي
grammar.explain: To men: ادرس، اجلس، تعال. To women add -ي: ادرسي، اجلسي، تعالي. To groups: ادرسوا! Negate with لا: لا تذهب! = Don't go!
mistakes: Saying ادرس to a woman — women get ادرسي!
Saying ما تذهب for don't — commands negate with لا!

lessons.title: Negation: لا، ما، لم، لن
lessons.learn: Four NEVERS! لا + present (لا أدرس = I don't study), ما + past (ما درستُ = I didn't study), لم + bare present (لم أدرس = I didn't study), لن + present (لن أدرس = I won't study). Pick by TENSE!

grammar.title: لا/لم/لن/ما by tense
grammar.explain: لا أدرس (I don't study), لم أدرس / ما درستُ (I didn't study), لن أدرس (I won't study). لم eats endings: لم يدرسْ (he didn't study)!
mistakes: Saying لا درستُ — past needs ما or لم!
Saying لن درستُ — لن loves PRESENT verbs!

lessons.title: Opinions and أفضل
lessons.learn: Argue in Arabic! أعتقد أن… (I think that…), أفضل (better), أسوأ (worse), أكبر (bigger). أفعل pattern = comparatives! الأفضل = THE best. معك حق! = You're right!

grammar.title: أعتقد أن + أفعل comparatives
grammar.explain: أعتقد أن المترو أفضل (I think the metro is better). من = than: أكبر من بيتي (bigger than my house). الأفضل = the best!

examples.en: Cairo is bigger than my house.

mistakes: Saying أكثر أفضل — أفضل ALREADY means better!
Forgetting من: bigger THAN = أكبر من!

dialogue.en: I think the metro is better.

dialogue.r: wa anā aẓunn anna as-sayyāra asraʿ.
dialogue.en: And I suppose the car is faster.

lessons.title: Weather and plans
lessons.learn: Arabic weather! الجو بارد (it's cold), الجو حار (it's hot), تمطر (it's raining), تثلج (it's snowing). الجو = the air — weather lives in الجو! Plus future plans with سـ!

grammar.title: الجو + adjective
grammar.explain: الجو بارد (it's cold), الجو جميل (it's beautiful). Verbs: تمطر (it rains), تثلج (it snows). Future: سيكون الجو دافئا (it will be warm)!
mistakes: Saying هو بارد for weather — weather needs الجو!
